title: Attention from scratch
hook: Scaled dot-product attention in six lines, why the square root of d is there, and how a prompt reaches a pixel.

verified.claim: optimized_attention is chosen once at module load from several backends.
CrossAttention takes q from x and k, v from context.
flux attention applies RoPE and then calls optimized_attention.
All tables come from this lesson's lab, run here on a CPU.
The scale and the formula are eq. 1 and the footnote of Vaswani et al. 2017.

unchecked: We did not compare the backends' pixel output on one seed.
The figure of 77 tokens per chunk is the usual SD 1.5 chunk size in ComfyUI's tokenizer; the page does not measure a specific prompt.
